subject: Game Theory
title: Evolutionary Game Theory and AI
description: A 60-second lesson on Evolutionary Game Theory and AI.

hook.text: Training AI agents to play games against each other is evolutionary game theory in digital form.

buildup.text: OpenAI trained hide-and-seek bots that independently evolved tool use, teamwork, and counter-strategies.

discovery.text: Multi-agent AI systems develop arms races: as one agent improves, others must adapt or fail.

twist.text: These dynamics can produce emergent behavior that designers never planned or even imagined.

climax.text: Understanding evolutionary games helps AI safety: predicting how agents behave when competing.

punchline.text: AI agents evolve like species compete.

quiz.question: Why is evolutionary game theory relevant to AI?
options: Multi-agent systems develop arms races and emergent behavior
